title: Fourier Scan Work Bound
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers, let $P$ be a subset of an $n$-element index set, and let $\delta$ be rational with $0<\delta\le1/2$. Put $d=n-|P|$, $r=\lfloor3k/4\rfloor$, and let $\mathcal F$ be the subsets of a $d$-element set of size at most $r$. Define $\alpha=1/(3\cdot2^k)$ and $\eta=\delta/(4|\mathcal F|T_k)$, where $T_0=1$ and $T_{j+1}=1+2T_j$. For $q>0$, set $B(q)=\lceil\log_2\lceil2/q\rceil\rceil$ and $S=\lceil2B(\eta)/\alpha^2\rceil$. Then $|\mathcal F|Sr\le (r+1)(n+1)^r\bigl(4B(\eta)/\alpha^2\bigr)(r+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a subset of an $n$-element index set
